integrity: The general conditional-Gaussian kurtosis integral was previously established; only the specified asymptotic classification and second-chaos limit are assessed. Bibliographic priority remains best-knowledge; independent scientific assessment not performed.
scientific_limitations: Stationary independent diffusivity of finite second moment with nonnegative covariance asymptotic to c h^{-eta}, 0<eta<1; the distributional chaos limit additionally requires the specific positive Gaussian-square environment and 0<2H<eta/2. No process-level limit or nonstationary renewal claim.
title: Sharp Gaussianization regimes and a hidden second-chaos limit in fractional diffusion with persistent diffusivity
